The following events take place in '''1196 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Hathrox III]] was the site of a biochemical [[Hathrox III civil war|civil war]]. One army unleashed a [[plague]], believing it has a foolproof [[Virus|antivirus]]. However, the disease wiped out the entire population of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and caused the planet to still be listed as a standing hazard during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="TCSWE" />
